scope: Original early compilation and selected-player relation behavioral evidence only. No feature acceptance or full regression claim.
required_receiving: Verify terminal original run/job/attempt and source/validation commit parents/trees
Download original artifact; verify metadata byte count and digest, ZIP CRC and exact manifest
Verify raw identities, totals, unique labels, no skipped/errors, exact fourteen negative frames
Verify both compiler outputs and all normal/mutant/restored source forms
Verify protected archive hashes, goldens, legacy fixtures, v0.7 and reserved games
next_on_pass: Retain bounded early receipt only. Continue original-source player protection/source-instance and public-flow gaps; full final-source regressions mandatory before feature acceptance.
next_on_failure: Preserve original evidence exactly once, diagnose actual cause and freeze a justified new immutable successor; never count compilation or unrelated failures as behavioral controls.
repair: Exact first frame pins30/44/80; executable source/tests/assertions/mutant unchanged. No R1 acceptance.
